headline: Cal State LA yet to concede after three wins
dek: Cal State LA have won all three of their matches without conceding a goal, and Abraham Ramirez has made thirteen saves behind them for three shutouts. Every other unbeaten side in the conference has already been scored on.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific's twelve goals have come from four different scorers, and the total is more than Cal State East Bay, Menlo and UC Merced have managed between them.

wire.line: Fresno Pacific have scored twelve goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ten matches on the schedule, every one of them dated before the first published result, have passed with no result recorded. No final is missing its score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match with a published result has no box score behind it: Fresno Pacific's win at Pacific in August, for which no collected schedule page carried a link.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay have conceded ten goals, more than any other programme, and have yet to win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cal State San Bernardino have conceded one goal across an unbeaten start of two wins and a draw.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Alexis Cervantes has taken thirteen shots for Stanislaus State and scored three times.

last_match.line: A win, a draw and a defeat for Dominguez Hills so far, with no two results alike.

next_match.line: Fresno Pacific's only defeat came at home, to Cal State San Bernardino; Dominican have already drawn at both UC Merced and Cal State East Bay.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
